methods.material_creation: UberTextMaterial..ctor 0x06000124 new Material(original shader) then Query.ApplyToMaterial

not_a_visual_fudge: The increment10 is applied independently to both Renderer.sortingOrder and the shader-derived material renderQueue. Do not arbitrarily add another sortingOrder or Z offset. The original queue is cached once, so repeat apply does not accumulate increments.
queue_mapping_note: Original Shader29 tag is QUEUE=Transparent; its standard Unity queue is3000. The managed method does not hardcode3000: it reads the freshly created shader material renderQueue once and adds10.
